question: When is the cutoff time for same-day dispatch?
expected_answer: Orders confirmed before 1 PM KST on business days are handed to the courier the same afternoon.

question: How much does Priority shipping cost?
expected_answer: Priority shipping is 5,000 won with guaranteed next-business-day delivery by noon. Gold-tier members receive it for free.

question: Which courier handles deliveries?
expected_answer: All domestic orders are fulfilled through Hanjin Express.

question: Can I pick up my order at a convenience store?
expected_answer: Yes, select CU Convenience Store Pickup at checkout. Your package is held for 5 calendar days before being returned.

question: Is there an extra fee for delivery to Jeju Island?
expected_answer: No surcharge. Delivery to Jeju and offshore islands takes an additional 1-2 business days.

question: What is the return period?
expected_answer: Products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery, provided they are unopened or unused with original packaging.

question: Are clearance items eligible for returns?
expected_answer: No. Products in the Clearance category and downloadable digital goods are final sale and cannot be returned.

question: How do I start a return?
expected_answer: In the Cholog app or website, go to My Orders, tap the order, select Request Return, choose a reason, and upload at least one photo.

question: How quickly are Kakao Pay refunds processed?
expected_answer: Kakao Pay and Naver Pay refunds are typically instant after the returned item is inspected.

question: Is there a fee for returning an item I changed my mind about?
expected_answer: Yes, a handling fee of 3,000 won is deducted from your refund for non-defect returns.

question: Do you accept Apple Pay?
expected_answer: Yes, we support Apple Pay along with Kakao Pay, Naver Pay, and Toss Pay.

question: Can I pay with two different methods on one order?
expected_answer: Yes, select Split Payment at checkout to combine up to two methods. Gift card balances can also be combined with any other method.

question: What is the minimum order for interest-free installments?
expected_answer: Orders totaling 30,000 won or more are eligible for 2- or 3-month interest-free installments on BC Card and NH Card.

question: What happens if my payment is declined?
expected_answer: The order is not placed and no charge is made. Common reasons include insufficient funds, daily limits, or an expired card.

question: What do I need to create an account?
expected_answer: A valid email address or Korean mobile number. You can also register using Kakao, Naver, or Google SSO. New accounts get a 3,000 won welcome coupon.

question: How much is 1 loyalty point worth?
expected_answer: 1 point equals 1 won. Points can be used on any future order with a minimum redemption of 1,000 points.

question: When do loyalty points expire?
expected_answer: Points expire 12 months from the date they are earned.

question: What spending is needed for VIP tier?
expected_answer: Spend over 800,000 won in a calendar year. VIP benefits include free Priority shipping, 5% point reward, early access to launches, and a dedicated support line.

question: How long does account deletion take?
expected_answer: After confirming, deletion is scheduled within 7 business days. All personal data, order history, and payment tokens are purged per PIPA.

question: How do I know if a product is almost sold out?
expected_answer: Each product page shows real-time status. Low Stock means fewer than 5 units remain.

question: What is the Cholog Essentials brand?
expected_answer: Cholog Essentials is our in-house brand covering stationery, desk organizers, and tech accessories. All carry a 2-year warranty.

question: Can I request a product you do not carry?
expected_answer: Yes, use the Product Request form. If 50 or more requests are received within 30 days, the merchandising team evaluates sourcing it.

question: What warranty do electronics have?
expected_answer: All electronics come with a minimum 1-year manufacturer warranty. Cholog Essentials electronics carry an extended 2-year warranty.

question: What are the Live Chat hours on weekends?
expected_answer: Live Chat is available 8 AM to 10 PM KST daily, including weekends.

question: How long does email support take to respond?
expected_answer: We respond within 12 hours on business days. Email address is support@cholog.kr.

question: Is there a VIP-only support phone number?
expected_answer: Yes, VIP members can call the priority line at 1588-0002 for immediate assistance.

question: Can I talk to a human on KakaoTalk?
expected_answer: Yes, search @초록 to chat with our AI assistant 24/7. Human agent handoff is available during Live Chat hours.

question: How do I file a complaint?
expected_answer: Go to Help Center > Submit Feedback. Complaints receive acknowledgment within 2 hours and a full response within 48 hours.

question: Can I schedule a phone callback?
expected_answer: Yes, select Request Callback in the Help Center. Enter your number and preferred time slot. Available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM KST.

question: Is customer support available in English?
expected_answer: Yes, Live Chat and email support are available in Korean and English. English phone support agents can be connected upon request.

question: What subscription plans do you offer?
expected_answer: Three types: Essentials Box (29,900 won/month), Coffee Club (19,900 won bi-weekly), and Beauty Box (39,900 won/month). All include free shipping.

question: Can I pause my subscription without canceling?
expected_answer: Yes, tap Pause in Settings > Subscriptions to skip the next delivery or halt all deliveries for up to 3 months. No charge during pause.

question: What is the minimum bulk order quantity?
expected_answer: Minimum bulk order is 50 units or 500,000 won, whichever is met first. Contact b2b@cholog.kr.

question: How is my personal data protected?
expected_answer: Data is encrypted with TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest. We comply with PIPA and GDPR. Annual third-party audits by a KISA-certified firm.

question: Can I download a copy of all my personal data?
expected_answer: Yes, go to Settings > Privacy > Download My Data. A ZIP file is prepared within 48 hours and available for 7 days.

question: What devices does the Cholog app support?
expected_answer: iOS 15+ and Android 10+. The website supports Chrome 90+, Safari 15+, Firefox 100+, and Edge 90+.

question: Do gift cards expire?
expected_answer: Yes, gift cards are valid for 5 years from the date of purchase.

question: Is the website accessible for users with disabilities?
expected_answer: Yes, designed to meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with screen reader support, keyboard navigation, adjustable fonts, and high-contrast mode.

question: What is the product take-back recycling program?
expected_answer: Bring used electronics to a CU convenience store collection point. You receive 2,000 points per item. Large items can be picked up from your address for free.

question: Can I cancel an order before it ships?
expected_answer: Yes, tap Cancel Order in My Orders while the status is Preparing. Cancellation is instant with a full refund.

question: What is the difference between a coupon and store credit?
expected_answer: Coupons have conditions (minimum order, expiry, category) and one per order. Store credit is applied automatically, has no minimum order, and can be combined with coupons and points.

question: How does the birthday coupon work?
expected_answer: A 20% off coupon (max 15,000 won) is auto-issued on the 1st of your birthday month. Plus and VIP members receive an additional gift.

question: What is Cholog Care+ extended protection?
expected_answer: Extended protection for electronics covering accidental damage, battery degradation, and component failure for 2 years beyond manufacturer warranty. Costs 10-15% of product price.

question: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
expected_answer: Yes, select Exchange instead of Refund when initiating a return. Choose replacement size or color. Price differences are charged or refunded.

question: How do I become a seller on Cholog Marketplace?
expected_answer: Apply at seller.cholog.kr with business registration, product catalog, and bank details. Review takes 5 business days.

question: Can international customers place orders?
expected_answer: Currently only Korean delivery addresses are accepted. International physical shipping is planned for Q3 2026. Digital gift cards and downloads are available.

question: What is the referral program reward?
expected_answer: Both referrer and referred friend receive 5,000 won store credit when the friend makes their first purchase. No limit on referrals. Credits expire in 90 days.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
expected_answer: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Choose SMS or authenticator app. A 6-digit code is required at every login.

question: Does the warranty cover accidental damage?
expected_answer: No, standard warranties cover manufacturing defects only. Purchase Cholog Care+ for accidental damage protection.

question: What is the Daily Check-In reward?
expected_answer: Open the app daily and tap Check In. Day 1-6: 50 points each. Day 7: 500 points or a random coupon. 30 consecutive days earns a 10,000 won coupon.
